prompts: Check the graph for orphans and broken links, and fix whatever you find.
Run a graph health check on the Atlas folder only.
Graph health: there is a note in Atlas/Notes whose frontmatter has up: [[Some Topic]] written as a plain value, not a list. What does lint say about it?
Lint, then apply every fix you proposed.

assertions.check: The agent presents a findings report grouped by category, with counts and one line per finding, before editing any file.
The agent changes no file until the user has said which fixes to apply.
A note in Atlas/Notes with no up: is reported as a finding (schema drift), not silently skipped.
An up: written as a scalar instead of a YAML list is flagged as a finding.
After fixes are applied, the agent adds one log entry in the form '## [YYYY-MM-DD] lint | N findings, M fixed'.
